explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/424: starting from {2, 3} and repeatedly adding a_i a_j - 1 (i ≠ j), does the generated set have positive density? Positive lower density is proved (Korsky). This variant takes the literal reading: the natural density exists and is positive (HasPosDensity). Whether the density exists is not settled, so the open tag is appropriate. generatedSet correctly encodes the closure. Faithful.
